notes.title: Shenzhou-16 launch celebration bundle
notes.content:

We would like to let you know that some of your and our favourite games are on sale!

[b]Interkosmos[/b] and [b]Interkosmos 2000[/b] can now be brought in a Shenzhou-16 launch celebration bundle together with 20% discount until June 14th! All space fanatics can enjoy both of our games at a great price during this limited time offer. You can enjoy acrobatics in VR, whether on Steam or Meta, you’ll be able to experience space from the comfort of your own home. 

In addition, you’ll be able to enjoy the bizarre world of [b]Metamorphosis[/b] and face challenges in the shoes of an insect as it will come discounted by [b]20% [/b]on Steam between June 7th - 14th! Try first person insect parkour, solve puzzles and overcome obstacles in an imaginative world, and reveal the truth of your transformation.

notes.title: Space Telescopes Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351263/c86837240190d230cd3994fe70832aaf7b56b41c.png[/img]

Hello Astronauts,

A new update for Interkosmos 2000 has landed! The update brings two new missions under the name Space Telescopes. The latest update will bring the opportunity to visit the legendary Hubble and mighty Kepler Space Telescopes, which will deliver fanatics images of outer space. 

Once again, command your spaceship and venture into the cosmos to discover the undiscovered. This update will keep the science alive, but only with your help! Endeavour into space and bring Hubble and mighty Kepler back online

notes.title: Hotfix for Vive Controllers
notes.content:
Some of you astronauts had problems with HTC VIVE controllers not working properly (not being able to grab anything). After some investigations we think we found the culprit.

This patch should fix this problem and allow you to grab, push, pull, switch and do all the other stuff with your controllers. 

Now go on and enjoy VR spaceflight on your personal computers and make space great again!

notes.title: 3, 2, 1 We have a liftoff!
notes.content:
Engines had their final checks and are ready to launch Interkosmos 2000 onto Steam. We know how much you’ve all been anticipating this space journey and we’re happy that our game is finally available on all major VR headsets.

Don’t hesitate and take advantage of the 10% launch discount while it lasts (till Thursday 23rd)! Now make sure you’re strapped into your seat before we lose gravity in the shuttle.

Some of the key features of Interkosmos 2000:

- Experience the feeling of an astronaut: manage engines, control navigation and guidance systems, maintain environmental systems, solve problems that may arise, dock with space stations, avoid asteroids and other obstacles, experience a virtual flight over Earth and re-enter Earth's atmosphere.
- Try out a fascinating story mode that takes you from launch to landing.
- Immerse yourself in a world with extraordinary graphics and admire the galactic panorama as you journey through space in a capsule inspired by real shuttles filled with buttons, switches and levers. The experience will be even more realistic thanks to surround sound effects.
- Enjoy the thrilling story mode and fly through space in an open sandbox mode.  

The game has come a long way since its release on Meta Quest Store and with today’s release new languages have been added: German, French, Spanish and Chinese.
